jobs.description:
Your role 
 This is a role with real impact, ownership, and visibility from day one. As Junior App Product Owner (all genders) You will join one of Sunday Natural’s most important digital initiatives as the first version of our app launches and help shape its future product and customer experience.
 Working closely with our Senior Product Owner, you will own defined app areas end to end – from identifying customer problems and defining requirements to coordinating development, launching features, and measuring their impact.

 Own defined app features end to end – from identifying customer problems and defining solutions to development, launch, performance analysis, and continuous improvement.

 Conduct user research in German and English, analyze customer journeys, app usage, funnels, and feedback, and turn insights into actionable improvements.

 Support experiments and A/B tests, explore AI-powered features and agents, and prepare product updates and follow-ups for senior leadership.

 You are passionate about digital products, customer-centricity, and developments in health, technology, and AI.

 You are analytical, comfortable with numbers, and interested in product metrics, conversion funnels, experimentation, and A/B testing.

 You communicate clearly, bring stakeholders together, are comfortable interviewing customers in German, and have gained initial experience in a relevant field; you are fluent in German and English at C1 level 

 What you can expect 
 Join a major digital initiative from the beginning and actively shape a completely new platform.

 Take on real responsibility, visibility, and end-to-end ownership of meaningful product areas from day one.

 Work closely with and receive mentoring from an experienced Senior Product Owner.

 Collaborate with a Staff Engineer, external app development specialists, and teams across IT, Design, CRM, Data, Marketing, Product Development, and Customer Experience.

 Participate in selected senior leadership and C-level product discussions.

 Build expertise in product ownership, customer research, digital analytics, experimentation, stakeholder management, and AI, with clear growth potential into a broader Product Owner or Product Manager role.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager - Enterprise & Commercial (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 What You'll Own 
 Enterprise Quote-to-Cash, the deal process from tender through signed, negotiated MSA, for accounts where "enterprise" is defined by scale, multi-entity structure, and formal procurement, not just deal size.

 Command's enterprise view, the RBAC, reporting, and admin experience Tailored and Named Accounts depend on, including reporting cut for five distinct stakeholders on a single deal: Global Learning, HR, Procurement, Global Mobility, and Local HR.

 The Franchise Portal, including a live, unresolved governance question about its reporting line that you'll be a real party to, not just informed of.

 This pod's Critical User Journeys, authored by you, not handed down. The Enterprise Q2C journey and the franchisee royalty journey are both named as priorities with no step-level detail written up yet, that's real work waiting for this seat, not a backlog item.

 Growth & Website, currently a single flex PM seat reporting to you, covering the self-serve funnel for Career Professionals and Self Serve Employers. You own the LTV:CAC review this seat's future shape is gated on, whether it stays a flex seat, becomes a permanent Senior PM role, or eventually justifies splitting off as its own fourth pod is your call to make and defend.

 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Enterprise deals close without last-minute discoveries on security, works council, or data residency, because those requirements were built into the process from the start, not patched in during a live tender.

 The enterprise segment threshold, currently defined three different ways across Command, the Q2C pipeline, and the Franchise Portal, gets resolved to one number under your ownership, since you're one of the parties who has to agree to it.

 Both named CUJs in this pod get written, reviewed, and become the thing specs and launch gates actually check against.

 A defensible, evidence-based recommendation on the Growth & Website gate, made and owned by you, whichever way the evidence actually points.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Real enterprise sales-cycle fluency. You should be able to speak comfortably about tender and RFP processes, executive sponsorship, and multi-entity contracting, not just SMB or self-serve motions.

 Comfort with compliance-adjacent product work. Security questionnaires, SOC 2, GDPR, works council co-determination (Germany and Austria specifically, under Section 87(1) No. 6 BetrVG) are not edge cases here, they're weekly reality.

 A track record of writing specs yourself, not just reviewing them.This pod's model is GPMs who still build, not GPMs who only manage.

 Fluency with data and, increasingly, AI tools, to do the analysis behind this pod's biggest bets personally rather than only consuming a dashboard someone else built.

 The judgment to know when a principle should bend.Berlitz has a real precedent for this: when its largest account needed configuration ahead of a fixed launch date, the answer was a deliberate, documented exception, not a quiet workaround, and not a rigid refusal either.

 At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

 What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end 
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which

 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention

 What we are looking for You might be a fit if:

Gemeinsam mit deinem Team sorgst du dafür, dass technische Anforderungen strukturiert bewertet, konzipiert und in nachhaltige Lösungen für unser ERP-System APplus überführt werden.
In deiner Rolle verbindest du  People Leadership mit technischer und operativer Steuerung . Du schaffst Transparenz über laufende Themen, Kapazitäten, Risiken und Prioritäten, entwickelst dein Team weiter und stellst klare Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards sicher.
Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf der Nähe zu unserem Produkt: Du behältst technische Konsistenz, Standardnähe und Wiederverwendbarkeit im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass Erfahrungen und Anforderungen aus Projekten sinnvoll in die Weiterentwicklung von APplus einfließen.
 
 Deine Aufgaben: 
 Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung deines Lead-Development-Teams
 Coaching der Mitarbeitenden sowie Durchführung regelmäßiger Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche
 Planung, Priorisierung und Steuerung laufender technischer Themen und Teamkapazitäten
 Herstellung von Transparenz über Auslastung, Risiken, Blocker und Prioritätskonflikte
 Begleitung und Bewertung technischer Konzepte, Risikoanalysen, Aufwandsschätzungen und Reviews
 Sicherstellung von Standardnähe, technischer Konsistenz und Wiederverwendbarkeit bei der Konzeption von Lösungen
 Frühzeitige Identifikation von Eskalationsbedarf sowie Treffen und Vorbereiten technischer und organisatorischer Entscheidungen
 Etablierung klarer Arbeitsweisen, Übergaben und Qualitätsstandards innerhalb des Teams
 Rückkopplung relevanter Erkenntnisse und Anforderungen aus Projekten in die Produktentwicklung
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Software Development, Product Management, Consulting, Projektmanagement, SLM, DevOps und Update Engineering
 Begleitung von Veränderungen und aktive Mitgestaltung unserer technischen Organisation
 

 Dein Profil Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, technischen Konzeption oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld 
 Sehr gutes Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen sowie technischer Konzeption, Aufwandsschätzung, Risikoanalyse und Reviews 
 Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung komplexer Softwareprodukte 
 Führungspotenzial und Motivation, Verantwortung für Menschen und ein technisches Team zu übernehmen 
 Fähigkeit, Orientierung zu geben, klares Feedback zu vermitteln und Verbindlichkeit herzustellen 
 Technisches Verständnis, mit dem du Konzepte, Risiken und technische Entscheidungen fundiert bewerten kannst 
 Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar vorzubereiten 
 Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise 
 Sichere Kommunikation mit technischen und fachlichen Stakeholdern 
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes Business-Englisch 
 
   Nice to have: 
 Erste fachliche oder disziplinarische Führungserfahrung, beispielsweise durch Mentoring, 1:1s, Feedbackgespräche oder die Koordination eines technischen Teams 
 Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von ERP-, Enterprise- oder anderen komplexen Standardsoftwarelösungen 
 Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktentwicklung und kundennahen Bereichen 
 Verständnis für Customization und kundenspezifische Softwareentwicklung 
 Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD, Testumgebungen oder in der Zusammenarbeit mit DevOps 
 Erfahrung mit Release- und Update-Prozessen 
 Erfahrung mit Kapazitätsplanung, Forecasting oder der Steuerung paralleler technischer Initiativen 
 Erfahrung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungsprozessen, Rollen oder Qualitätsstandards 
 Kenntnisse von APplus oder vergleichbaren ERP-Systemen 
 

 Unser Angebot Vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Du Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein Potenzial langfristig einbringen kannst

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.
 LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 
 You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.

 Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) 
 Confluence 
 Google Workspace  
 LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications 
 Figma  
 QGIS and comparable viewers 
 STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: 
 very high resolution optical imagery 
 synthetic aperture radar 
 3D surface models  
 cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments 
 agentic tools for a variety of work. 
 

 Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.
 Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

 Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

 Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

 Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

 Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

 Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.

 

 Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

 Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

 Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

 German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

 German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

 Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

 You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

jobs.description:
Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.
 
 You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track.  
 
 This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

 Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
 Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success  
 Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
 Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
 Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
 Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 
 

 Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
 Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
 Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
 Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
 Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 
 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
 IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
 Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
 Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
 Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
 Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
 Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
 Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
 Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

 Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

 At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

 As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

 As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
 You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
 You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
 You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
 You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
 You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
 You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 
 

 Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
 Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
 Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
 Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
 Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
 Business fluency in both  English and German  is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff.  
 

 What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible:  We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

 Room to grow // Stay curious:  In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

 Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active:  We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

 Taking responsibility // We #care:  We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Our Global Structure 

 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

 Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our London team. In this role, you'll help us expand our on-demand grocery and retail offering, building a trusted shopping experience that customers rely on for their everyday local commerce needs.

 

 What You'll Be Doing 

 You'll be joining the New Verticals team. New Verticals is Deliveroo's business for on-demand grocery and retail: expanding what customers can buy on Deliveroo beyond restaurants, from everyday essentials to products from well-known brands and local stores. It's a key growth area for the company, focused on building a trusted, repeatable shopping experience.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 
 Own high-impact growth problems end-to-end, identifying opportunities across the customer lifecycle—from acquisition and activation to retention and monetisation.

 
 Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Commercial to align on priorities and drive execution from concept to launch.

 
 Partner with Customer Research to uncover barriers to transaction and translate those insights into high-conviction growth bets.

 
 Design and run controlled experiments to understand how affordability and selection influence behaviour, validating hypotheses through data.

 
 Drive alignment and trade-offs by balancing customer experience with unit economics and marketplace dynamics, communicating clearly to senior stakeholders.

 
 
 What You'll Need to Thrive 

 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 
 
 Proven ability to solve complex problems, with a knack for asking the right questions and translating ambiguity into actionable roadmaps.

 
 High analytical fluency and significant experience being data-savvy, with the ability to diagnose performance drivers and partner effectively with Data Science.

 
 Demonstrated ownership of high-velocity execution, maintaining a sharp eye for detail in an environment where impact is paramount.

 
 Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience navigating trade-offs across diverse disciplines like Marketing, Operations, and Engineering.

 
 A growth mindset and the resilience to learn fast, adapt to failures, and keep moving forward in a highly experimental environment.

 

 
 Why Join Us? 

 At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

 We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale

 Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

 🌱 See your impact, fast

 Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership

 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

 🌎 A culture built for builders

 High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

 💰 Share in the success you help create

 Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.

This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. Day to day, you will:

  • Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
  • Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
  • Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
  • Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
  • Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
  • Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
  • Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.

What you’ll bring

  • A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
  • Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
  • The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
  • Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
  • A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
  • The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
  • The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
  • Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
  • Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.

Pfaffenhofen a. d. Ilm • Vollzeit • ab sofort

 Wir sind EXP Software GmbH: Wir sind ein Team aus rund 25 Softwareentwickler*innen mit Herz, Humor und Leidenschaft für Technologie. Wir bauen explore, eine Agentic-Twin-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, komplexe Prozesse durch autonome KI-Agenten abzubilden und zu automatisieren.Unser Produkt wächst und damit auch die Anforderungen an jemanden, der den Überblick behält: zwischen dem, was Kunden brauchen, was die Geschäftsführung vorhat, und dem, was das Entwicklungsteam realistisch umsetzen kann. Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden.

 Aufgaben

 Produktvision & Roadmap

 
 Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam.

 Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen.

 Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum?

 Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben.

 Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt.

 
 Team & Wissenstransfer

 
 Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut.

 Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen.

 Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind.

 Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung.

 
 Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung

 
 Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein.

 Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen.

 Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen.

 Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert.

 Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss.

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer (a)
jobs.description:
Über uns MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
 Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) 
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

 Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
 Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
 Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
 Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
 Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
 Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
 Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
 Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
 Actively contributing to internal discussions.
 Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
 As Project Officer,  the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
 As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.
 

 We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
 As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
 As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

 The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. 

 As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

 Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

 Our humble expectations 

 You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

 
 Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 

 It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. 

 Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

 High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.

 Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.

 Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.

 Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

 
 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Product Manager  H/F
jobs.description:
Product Manager – Innovation & Design

Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.

 

Capco recherche des Product Managers pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.

Au sein de notre capability Tech, Product & Engineering, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.

Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.

Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.

 

Vos responsabilités 

  • Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.
  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.
  • Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.
  • Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.

Compétences et expériences désirées  

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.
  • Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.
  • Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.
  • Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.
  • Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. 

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

jobs.title: Project Manager |  Customer Engagement & Communication (H/F)
jobs.description:
🤝 Qui nous sommes 

 Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.

 Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale :

 Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.

 Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.

 Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care , bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.

 Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.

 La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.

 

 
 🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

 Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

 
 Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.

 Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.

 Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.

 
 Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.

 

 
 👉 Tes futures missions 

 Engagement clients 

 
 
 Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...

 Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.

 Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

 
 
 Engagement utilisateurs 

 
 Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.

 Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care.

 Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...

 
 
 Notoriété et thought leadership 

 
 Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.

 Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.

 Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.

 
 

 L'entraide est très importante chez Moka. 

 De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

 📇 Tu es la personne idéale si 

 
 Tu as au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne. 

 Tu es à l'aise à l'oral , et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.

 Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie , organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.

 Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.

 Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design (nous utilisons Figma ). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo , c’est un vrai plus.

 Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche.

 Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais , te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

 
 🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

 
 Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.

 Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.

 Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail. 

 Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.

 Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

 
 🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
 We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.
 The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
 This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.
 What you'll do 
 Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

 What we're looking for 
 Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

 AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

 High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

 Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

 Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

 Backgrounds that tend to fit 
 Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

 MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

 Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

 Why this is interesting 
 Competitive, top-of-market compensation

 You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

 Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

 Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

 US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

  • Uses data and user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
