jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
TL;DR - Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.
 You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.
 
 Why Lovable? 
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
 
 Who you are 
 A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.

 Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.

 Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.

 Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.

 Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.

 Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.

 
 What we’re looking for 
 6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.

 Experience at a high tech company.

 Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to paid to expansion journey.

 A track record of writing customer facing content, campaigns, or messaging that you can speak to in detail, and that you can point to measurable outcomes for.

 Experience partnering with product, growth, or lifecycle teams to bring messaging into their workflows, without owning the underlying roadmap or systems.
 Preferred: 

 Experience working alongside lifecycle or CRM tools such as Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io , even if you weren't the one operating them.

 Familiarity with growth metrics and experimentation frameworks (PQLs, activation rate, feature adoption) enough to speak the same language as a Growth PM.

 Experience working with developer, startup, or solo builder audiences.

 Experience building messaging frameworks or toolkits that scaled across multiple teams.

 
 What you’ll do 
 Own messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey, from signup through activation and expansion.

 Partner with the Growth PM to translate their roadmap and experimentation priorities into strong, on-brand messaging, bringing your own point of view on framing and positioning rather than just executing briefs.

 Work hand in hand with the Lifecycle team on new content and messaging for email, in-app surfaces, and push notifications, ensuring everything reflects our positioning and voice.

 Develop clear point of view documents and messaging guidance for different self serve segments (solo founders, indie hackers, small teams) that inform both lifecycle content and broader growth campaigns.

 Write and refine copy for high leverage touchpoints: onboarding flows, activation nudges, upgrade prompts, and in-app messaging.

 Review and sharpen messaging coming out of experiments and campaigns, helping the team understand not just whether something worked, but why, from a messaging and positioning lens.

 Build a shared messaging toolkit (voice, tone, positioning by segment, proof points) that Lifecycle and Growth can both draw from.

jobs.description:
Product Manager – Compliance
 
 Help Shape the Future of AI Compliance in Financial Services
 Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognized as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025, we are backed by leading investors and supported by major financial institutions as we scale rapidly amid accelerating AI adoption in financial services.
  
 Our platform enables some of the UK’s largest financial institutions to deploy AI safely in FCA-regulated environments, powering everything from compliance monitoring to AI-driven adviser guidance.
  
 We are seeking a Product Manager – Assurance to play a central role in Aveni’s Assurance portfolio: products that help financial services firms govern, test, and assure AI agents and human interactions across the customer journey.
  
 The Role
 This role is primarily focused on Agent Approve, Aveni’s pre-deployment simulation and testing product, with additional responsibility for Detect, our post-interaction compliance assessment product.
  
 Agent Approve is a growth-stage product operating in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will own the product from discovery through commercial readiness, helping define Aveni’s position in an emerging market.
  
 This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Assurance Products on strategy and roadmap direction while independently driving discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and go-to-market readiness. You will work with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and commercial teams to turn complex customer and regulatory problems into clear, valuable, and shippable product outcomes.
  
 You are well suited to this role if you enjoy operating in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex problem spaces, and possess the judgement to prioritize effectively, distinguishing what matters, what can wait, and what needs validation before building.
  
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Own the Agent Approve and Detect product roadmaps from problem discovery and opportunity sizing through prioritisation, delivery, and launch readiness.

 Lead continuous discovery with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders, developing an evidence-based view of market direction and urgent problem areas.

 Translate ideas and customer problems into low- and high-fidelity prototypes to validate assumptions early, reduce delivery risk, and accelerate decision-making.

 Collaborate closely with engineering and design to convert strategy into executable delivery plans, maintain a prioritized backlog, and support squads through delivery.

 Build strong relationships across engineering, commercial, customer success, and marketing, serving as a trusted voice on what we are building, why it matters, and how it supports Aveni's Assurance portfolio.

 Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity in financial services compliance, QA technology, and AI assurance, ensuring product decisions are grounded in market context.

 Use data and metrics to inform prioritization, define product KPIs, and measure the success of features and capabilities.

  
 What We’re Looking For
 Proven experience as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally owning a roadmap from discovery to delivery.

 Domain expertise in financial services, compliance, risk, or regulatory technology, and experience leading stakeholder discovery and translating insights into product strategy.

 Strong product judgement, clear communication skills, and confidence in shaping problem spaces, defining direction, defending prioritization decisions, and explaining trade-offs to diverse audiences.

 Analytical rigor, comfort using data to guide decisions, and ability to build trusted relationships with engineers, designers, and senior commercial stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (JetBrains Context)
jobs.description:
Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.

This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.

Day to day, you will:

  • Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.
  • Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.
  • Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.
  • Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.
  • Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.
  • Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.
  • Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.
  • Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.

What you’ll bring

  • A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.
  • Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.
  • The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.
  • Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.
  • A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.
  • Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.
  • The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.
  • The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.
  • Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.
  • Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.

Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its gover

You will be at the helm of further developing and deploying a high-profile, highly complex strategic project that fundamentally redefines our production methods and capabilities across our DCs.
Working closely with Tech and Operations Leadership, you will be responsible for taking our new, next-generation production setup and refining its processes, equipment, and layouts. Once optimized, you will lead the charge in deploying this new operational blueprint into other DCs across our international markets.
This is not a traditional desk-bound product role; it requires a strong operational background, deep understanding of physical process design, and the ability to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and on-the-ground execution. The international role will be based in our Berlin office and will involve frequent travel to our local warehouses across markets and potentially extended stays during roll-out periods.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

  • Lean Management & Continuous Improvement: You will apply Lean principles to continuously test, tweak, and optimize the operational setup and production capacity before, during, and after site rollouts.

  • Strategy and Planning: You will support the development of rollout strategies and produce the resulting project plans, ensuring that we deploy at scale without disrupting ongoing operations.
  • Documentation and Standardization: You will drive towards clear and structured project documentation, clearly defining and outlining the solutions, requirements, … You will help us create standard deployment playbooks which speed up bringing our solutions to market.

What you’ll bring

  • Methodology: You have deep expertise in Lean Management principles and continuous improvement methodologies within a physical operational setting.

Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone
 Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.
 At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.
 I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.
 Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.
 That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.
 You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.
 — Grigory
 
Why Secfix exists
 Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.
 Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.
 We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.
 This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.
 
What you'll actually do in the first 3 months
 This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:
 Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.
 Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.
 Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.
 
What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?
 After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.
 You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.

 Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

 Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

 As much ownership as you can carry. We hand more to the people who prove they can run with it. Show us, and your scope grows fast.

 
 What you'll bring
 You think like a founder. You operate like an owner: figuring out what matters, making the call with incomplete information, and getting it done without waiting to be told.

 Impact. We don't count years in a PM title. If you spent two years building your own company and one year in product, that counts. We care about what you've built and the impact you've had.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Business Processes
jobs.description:
Welcome to the future of cloud networking and security!  

Cato Networks is the first company to converge enterprise networking and security into one centralized and global service that is delivered by cloud. It is led by networking and security pioneer Shlomo Kramer (Check Point, Imperva) and early investor (Palo Alto Networks, Exabeam, Trusteer and more). Cato’s unique technology inspired a brand-new product category, later named “SASE” by Gartner and a market expected to reach $28.5 billion by 2028.

This is your opportunity to get on the rocket ship and join a company that is building a cutting-edge enterprise network and secure cloud platform, and is on a fast track to becoming the worldwide market leader – don’t miss it!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cato Networks is building Product-Led Growth capabilities that complement its established enterprise, direct-sales, and partner-led business.

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own product-led customer journeys across Cato’s target markets, with a particular focus on SMB while also improving how larger enterprise customers discover, evaluate, activate, adopt, and expand Cato.

For SMB customers, this may include highly self-service journeys from signup and onboarding through value realization, purchase, and expansion. For larger enterprises, PLG will complement the sales-led motion by helping customers experience value sooner, adopt more effectively, identify expansion opportunities, and create stronger product-qualified demand.

This is an individual-contributor role. You will own measurable customer and business outcomes, working directly with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Channel, Customer Success, and Business Operations.

What You’ll Do 

  • Own and improve the end-to-end PLG journey across relevant customer segments: discover → evaluate → activate → experience value → adopt → convert → retain → expand.
  • Define segment-specific product-led journeys for SMB and enterprise customers, balancing self-service, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted experiences.
  • For SMB, drive simple self-service onboarding, guided configuration, sensible defaults, in-product education, packaging, upgrade paths, and purchase experiences.
  • For enterprise customers, identify ways to accelerate evaluation, activation, time-to-value, adoption, product-qualified demand, and expansion.
  • Define the key activation and “aha” moments for different customer segments, and improve time-to-first-value and unassisted or assisted activation.
  • Own product requirements related to trials, free experiences where relevant, packaging, entitlements, upgrade paths, pricing UX, purchase flows, and conversion triggers.
  • Define, instrument, and monitor PLG metrics, including activation, time-to-first-value, product adoption, conversion, product-qualified opportunities, retention, and expansion.
  • Use product analytics, customer research, funnel analysis, and experimentation to identify friction, test hypotheses, and continuously improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, Finance, and Business Operations to create seamless product-led, sales-assisted, and partner-assisted journeys.
  • Identify product-usage and behavioral signals that can trigger contextual recommendations, expansion opportunities, partner engagement, or sales outreach. 

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS.

Deine Aufgaben Zahlen, Tools und der Blick dahinter: Du machst sichtbar, was im Marketing wirkt. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Dashboards und unseres MarTech-Stacks, hältst Marketingdaten nachvollziehbar und unterstützt bei ersten KI-gestützten Automatisierungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit klaren Datenregeln, unter Anleitung und in Abstimmung mit Marketing, Vertrieb, IT und Datenschutz. Wenn dich reizt, wie aus Kanaldaten belastbare Entscheidungen werden, bist du hier richtig.
 Das erwartet dich. 

Reporting & Dashboards
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege von Dashboards und kanalspezifischen Kennzahlen auf Basis von Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads und LinkedIn. Du stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen mit einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik gekennzeichnet sind und die verwendeten Definitionen dokumentiert werden. 
 Du bereitest die monatlichen Marketingkennzahlen auf, prüfst Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Plausibilität und hilfst, verlässliche Ausgangswerte sowie Trends je Kanal zu etablieren. Abweichungen und Datenlücken dokumentierst du und stimmst sie mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern ab.
  
Analyse & Optimierung
 Du bist analytische Ansprechperson für die Performance unserer Kanäle und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team konkrete Optimierungen ab.
 Du unterstützt bei einer konsistenten UTM-Systematik, prüfst Kampagnenkennzeichnungen regelmäßig und dokumentierst Änderungen, Annahmen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar.
 Du bereitest Insights verständlich für das Team auf und erstellst kurze Anleitungen oder Einführungen für wiederkehrende Reports und Tools. Bei komplexen oder systemkritischen Themen arbeitest du mit den zuständigen Expert:innen zusammen.
 Du unterstützt dabei, unsere Sichtbarkeit in ausgewählten KI-Antworten und KI-Suchen systematisch zu beobachten. Du dokumentierst Suchanfragen, Ergebnisse und Veränderungen und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Team erste Hypothesen und Content-Maßnahmen ab.
 
 MarTech & Automatisierung
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres MarTech-Stacks. Dazu gehören die strukturierte Dokumentation eingesetzter Analytics- und Automatisierungstools, die Prüfung von Anforderungen sowie vorbereitende Tests und Abstimmungen für Systemanbindungen. Technische Architektur und produktive Änderungen erfolgen mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau der Marketing-Datenanbindung an unser CRM, in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Vertriebsteam und unter Einhaltung der Datenschutzvorgaben.
 Du unterstützt bei der Pflege und Qualitätssicherung unseres Trackings und Remarketings im Rahmen der freigegebenen Konzepte. Dabei dokumentierst du Messpunkte, prüfst die technische Funktion und meldest Abweichungen. Alle Maßnahmen erfolgen unter Beachtung der geltenden Datenschutz- und Einwilligungsvorgaben sowie in Abstimmung mit den zuständigen Verantwortlichen.
 Du unterstützt beim Konzipieren, Testen und Dokumentieren erster KI-gestützter Automatisierungen für wiederkehrende Marketingabläufe – unter Anleitung, mit klaren Datenregeln und definierten Freigaben. Du prüfst die Ergebnisse vor der Nutzung und entwickelst keine Automatisierungen, die ungeprüft externe Kommunikation auslösen oder sensible Daten verarbeiten.
 

 Dein Profil Du bist eingeschrieben in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, BWL mit Digital- oder Datenschwerpunkt, Marketing Management mit Analytics-Fokus oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. 
 Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Daten, Technologie und Marketing sinnvoll zusammenspielen.
 Erste praktische Erfahrung aus Praktika, Hochschulprojekten, studentischen Initiativen oder ehrenamtlichem Engagement ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, dich in verschiedene Themen einzuarbeiten.
 Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Analytics-Tools (z.B. Google Analytics 4), mit der Aufbereitung von Daten in Tabellen sowie mit KI-Tools (z.B. Claude) oder CRM-Systemen. Grundkenntnisse in SQL sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1).
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und selbstständig und hast Lust, dich in MarTech, neue Tools und KI-gestütztes Arbeiten einzuarbeiten.
 Du arbeitest gern mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpersonen zusammen und bist kommunikationsstark.
 

 Warum wir? Faire Vergütung: 18,50 € pro Stunde
Breiter Einblick: Du lernst Analytics, MarTech und datengetriebenes Marketing in einer Rolle kennen.
Echte Verantwortung: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und siehst die Ergebnisse deiner Arbeit.
Enge Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest im Marketingteam vor Ort und hast feste Ansprechpersonen.
Zentrale Lage: Unser Büro liegt am Ku’damm, bestens angebunden.

Wir bieten dir nicht nur eine Position, sondern eine Plattform, um deine Fähigkeiten zu entfalten und zu wachsen. Werde Teil unseres kleinen Teams mit kurzen Wegen und echtem G

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Document Domain
jobs.description:
PandaDoc is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the evolution of our Document Experience — redefining how professionals create, refine, collaborate on, and complete documents in an increasingly AI-driven world.

You’ll own the strategy and execution of PandaDoc’s core document experiences, shaping how structured content, collaboration, and intelligent assistance come together into cohesive workflows. Your work will help customers move faster from ideas to finalized agreements by making document creation more intuitive, adaptive, and connected.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of user experience, platform systems, and applied AI. You’ll guide multiple squads, align cross-functional partners, and translate emerging technologies into scalable product systems — balancing exploration with disciplined delivery.

In this role, you will

  • Lead high-impact initiatives across document creation, authoring and collaboration experiences.
  • Shape cohesive end-to-end document workflows, ensuring users can move naturally from drafting to completion.
  • Integrate AI capabilities directly into document experiences — including authoring, refinement, structure, and automation — with a focus on real user outcomes.
  • Define product direction for modern document systems, blending structured content, intelligent assistance, and collaborative workflows.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, AI platform, and core platform teams on APIs, integrations, and data models that enable scalable experiences.
  • Collaborate with other senior PMs to ensure consistent, connected journeys across PandaDoc.
  • Drive continuous improvement through experimentation, customer feedback, and product telemetry.
  • Shape the long-term direction of PandaDoc’s Document Domain, ensuring flexibility, coherence, and readiness for evolving AI-powered capabilities.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of hands-on product management experience in B2B SaaS, ideally across document creation, productivity, collaboration, or content platforms.
  • Proven experience owning complex user-facing domains end-to-end — from strategy through delivery and iteration.
  • Familiar with document systems, structured content, and cross-format editing models (PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or AI-generated content).
  • Direct experience shipping AI-powered product features, including defining UX behavior, rollout strategies, and iteration based on real-world usage.
  • Comfortable integrating AI into workflows thoughtfully, focusing on measurable user outcomes rather than standalone capabilities.
  • Skilled in rapid discovery and iteration using prototypes, experiments, and AI-assisted tools.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency — using AI for analysis, prototyping, and workflow automation, with strong judgment to translate ambiguous AI capabilities into dependable product experiences.
  • Strong communicator who simplifies complexity, frames trade-offs clearly, and aligns cross-functional teams.
  • Pragmatic and execution-oriented, balancing experimentation with prioritization and delivery discipline.
  • Comfortable partnering with deeply technical teams on system design, APIs, and platform constraints.

Company Overview: 

PandaDoc empowers more than 67,000 growing organizations to thrive by taking the work out of document workflow. PandaDoc provides an all-in-one document workflow automation platform that helps fast scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more.  For more information, please visit https://www.pandadoc.com.

Company Culture: 

We're known for our work-life balance, kind co-workers, & creative virtual team-bonding events. And although our Pandas are located across the globe, we stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on our team feels, well, like a team.

Pandas work best when they're happy. We retain our talent by upholding our values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of our customers. 

Check out our LinkedIn to learn more.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary. If you are based in Poland, the salary range is 31,000-40,000 PLN per month.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Horizontal Platform Poseidon
jobs.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

What's Exciting About The Role

This role places you at the centre of Verifone’s payment application strategy for the DACH region. You will shape the terminal application stack that powers one of Europe’s most complex and competitive payment markets — across attended, unattended, SmartPOS, SoftPOS, gateway, and 3rd Party App environments. You will influence product direction across all form factors, drive girocard and next‑generation initiatives like Victa, and own a horizontal product portfolio that touches every merchant segment.

For candidates who want broad ownership, strategic impact, and visibility across engineering, sales, and market leadership, this is one of the most influential product roles in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • BHE Poseidon App roadmap & Book of Work: End-to-end release planning and prioritisation across the DACH product portfolio (Victa series, NEO 2, Engage (until EOL) and future upcoming products) and the software attached to it.
  • Payment methods: Girocard (DK), ICS (International card Schemes, ELV/GLV, APMs, cashback, instalments, in future Wero (EPI) and Digital Euro
  • Customer variants: Like enterprise-specific builds. You know why the same terminal ships six different application variants — and can defend or consolidate that on the roadmap.
  • Estate & terminal management: VHQ 2.0 rollout and adoption, remote update, key management, and certificate management for Verifone and our customers.
  • Certification pipeline: PCI-PTS, P2PE vs non-P2PE, GBIC, DC POS / TA, DK certification cycles — you own the sequencing (not the certification itself) so the sales pipeline never stalls on a missing certificate.
  • Scheme & regulator alignment: Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft (DK), EURO Kartensysteme, Bundesbank/BaFin adjacencies, and equivalent bodies for AT and CH (SIX / EP2).
  • Sales & Ops alignment: Partner to DACH Region management and country sales on Book of Work, feature commitments, and customer escalations — from Partner conferences to enterprise merchants.
  • Engineering & ADC partnership: Tight collaboration with the Poseidon Engineering, and Hardware teams on release readiness, hardware supply topics (spares, EOL), and new form factors.
  • Hardware aspects: Cover the relevant workstreams to make a hardware product sellable in the DACH region.

Skills and Experience We Desire

  • Native or Business fluent German language
  • 5+ years of product management in the DACH/EU payments space — terminal vendor, PSP, acquiring, or network operator.
  • Broad payments fluency: girocard, international card schemes, SoftPOS, APMs, ELV/SEPA — and how a terminal management system (VHQ or equivalent) ties the estate together.
  • Technical foundation: ZVT-H / PSDK / SDI / EP2, EMV kernel, PCI-PTS, P2PE, PSD2 SCA. You do not need to code, but you read Engineering quotes and certification reports on your own.
  • Book of Work discipline: comfortable owning a multi-product, multi-customer release matrix and forcing prioritisation trade-offs.
  • Regulatory instinct: BaFin/ZAG context, DK/GBIC, ZAIT

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft 
 Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
 Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
 Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
 Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
 Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

 Deine Mission 
 KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
 Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
 Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
 Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
 Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
 Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
 Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.
 
 Dein Profil 
 Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
 KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. Solides Verständnis moderner LLM-Stacks: RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning vs. In-Context-Learning, Vektor-Stores. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
 Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
 Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
 KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
 Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
 Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
 Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.
 Domänen-Hintergrund: Erfahrung in Finance, Tax, Accounting oder angrenzenden Domänen ist ein st

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager - Italy (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about AI & renewable energy? 
 Do you thrive in fast-paced, hard-working and purpose-driven environments? If you're ready to use your skills to help leveraging our product to the next level and keep processes smooth, then look no further - we want YOU!
 
 Please note that for this role, C2 Italian proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin. 
 
 What You Will Do 
 Own the Italian Market: Be the PM for IT. Find what is missing and optimize

 Talk to Installers Constantly: Calls, site visits, demos, support tickets. You will know your installers the best

 Push metrics: Improve activation, adoption and retention for IT installers.

 Build for Local Rules: Ship features that fit IT reality, from compliance requirements to the things installers there do differently.

 Make It Reusable: Turn IT solutions into platform features every market can use.

 Set the UX/UI Bar: Review flows before they ship and push back on work that is technically correct but bad to use.

 Challenge and Collaborate: Work closely with Core Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 Hands-On Experience: 2+ years in product management, ideally in a startup or product-driven environment.

 Outcome driven: You have improved a metric before and can walk us through how you did it.

 Strong Research Skills: You combine qualitative and quantitative research to make informed product decisions.

 Strong Product Taste: You spot weak flows and can say exactly define why it is weak.

 Willingness to Travel: Roughly once per quarter to Italy to meet our customers on site.

 Language: Excellent English and Italian (Bonus:German).

 
 Why Join Us? 
 Be part of one of the fastest growing VC-backed startup in Germany with 3000+ satisfied B2B customers.

 A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face - we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

 Enjoy opportunities for personal and professional growth.

 Embrace the freedom to innovate and make quick changes in a dynamic team.

 Perks include gym membership, coffee, regular team events, MacBook and more.

 Receive competitive pay.

  
 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.
  
 About Reonic 
 At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Digital Plattform Automotive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben Über die Rolle 
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

 Deine Aufgaben 
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.

 Dein Profil Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
 Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
 Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
 Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
 Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
 Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.
 

 Warum wir? Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
 Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
 Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
 Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
 Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
 Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
 Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
 Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
 Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
 Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 
 

 Unser Standort Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Orchestration
jobs.description:
Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 About the team 
 Global merchants need better payment performance, resilience and control across providers, markets and payment methods - without building and maintaining the infrastructure themselves.
 We are building Checkout.com ’s next-generation orchestration product: a modular control layer that connects, routes, retries, vaults and reconciles payments across providers through a single integration.
 This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role. You will turn a complex payments problem into a product merchants trust with revenue-critical transactions and financial operations.
 
 What you’ll own 
 Set product strategy for a core part of orchestration, from merchant problem to measurable commercial impact.

 Work directly with enterprise merchants to understand their payment stack and highest-value problems, then turn those insights into a focused roadmap.

 Design reliable experiences across provider connectivity, routing, retries and fallbacks, token portability, reporting and reconciliation.

 Build the foundations: consistent APIs and data models, provider abstraction, observability, auditability and safe change management.

 Lead delivery with engineering, design, commercial, operations, risk, compliance and finance.

 Shape the path from pilot to enterprise adoption, including migration, controlled rollout, rollback and customer co-creation.

 Protect merchant trust by making routing decisions explainable, configurable and provider-neutral.
 

 What success looks like 
 In your first 12-18 months, you will have:
 Shipped a focused orchestration capability used in production by enterprise merchants.

 Built a repeatable discovery and co-creation model with strategic customers.

 Improved payment outcomes such as approval performance, recovered transactions, latency, cost or provider resilience.

 Reduced integration and operational effort for merchants and internal teams.

 
 What we are looking for 
 You understand payments end-to-end - including PSPs, acquirers, credentials, webhooks, settlement, refunds, disputes and reconciliation.

 You have built or scaled API-first, platform or infrastructure products where reliability and operational excellence matter.

 You are comfortable with data such as approval performance, recovered payments, latency, provider health, cost and reconciliation accuracy.

 You are a systems thinker who can simplify complexity without hiding the important detail.

 You can move from merchant discovery to product strategy, technical trade-offs and executive communication.

 You know how to sequence a modular product around the highest-value use cases, take ownership in ambiguity and follow through.

 Nice to have experience 
 Direct orchestration experience is valuable, but not essential.

 Deep experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer platforms or other reliability-critical B2B systems is equally relevant.

 
 Additional Information 
 Bring all of you to work 
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
 
 Life at Checkout.com 
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture

jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
 Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
 Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
 Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
 Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
 Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
 

 We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
 You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
 You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
 You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
 You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
 You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
 You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
 You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
 You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.
 

 What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
 Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
 Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
 €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
 EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
 In-house German classes
 Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
 International team, English-speaking environment

jobs.description:

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
 We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
 
 About the role: 
 As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional Head of Product - Clients . You will work closely with Florian Thiel , Christian Wöhlke , and the Product & Engineering teams of the tribe (3 domain teams in total). In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial leadership teams, owning topics critical to Upvest's product and business success.
 
 Lead the clients tribe's product vision and strategy: 
 As Head of Product, you start leading one of the Clients tribe teams directly, while guiding the overarching strategy and success of the Clients Tribe and you start scaling yourself. You will work very closely with the Director of Engineering and VP of Product to define the tribe's strategy, set OKRs, and shape the long-term roadmap. The goal: to power Upvest's asymmetric scaling by building the intelligent, seamless "AI-experience", internal and external, that makes flawless API experiences the foundation of Upvest's ecosystem.
 
 Drive asymmetric scaling through intelligent, agentic operations: 
 Your challenge is to make our tools and workflows scale without lockstep headcount growth.. That means embedding intelligence and automation into every process, and exploring how agentic operations, AI agents handling operational workflows end to end, can take on work that today needs manual effort. You'll be the go-to voice for applied AI across our tooling, helping the business run efficiently and helping clients get to market faster, at lower cost and higher reliability.
 
 Take tooling into its next stage: 
 You'll own the roadmap for Internal Tooling or Upfront, both key strategic product enablers for scaling the business, and drive it forward through OKRs, deciding where to push deeper automation, broaden coverage, or reimagine a workflow entirely. You'll work directly with the Engineering team, and stay close to the people the products serve, so every step forward is one that truly matters.

 
 What you’ll do: 
 Significant impact and strategic influence, shaping the roadmap and scaling strategy with a seat at the table with engineering and product leadership.

 Autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. You fully own the product success of your team and function.

 Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

 Product Engineering culture, working closely with engineering counterparts guided by joint OKRs and a clear roadmap.

 An exceptional team, combining impactful work with a relaxed, fun atmosphere and consistently high eNPS.

 Continuous learning across investments, API products, and a state-of-the-art tech stack.

 
 What you bring: 
 5+ years in Product Management, ideally with a focus on internal and/or external tooling. Financial services, compliance, or fintech experience is a big plus.

 Proven people leadership of teams of 3+ people.

 Firm grasp of UI/UX best practices; can ideate and prototype through lo-fi wireframes and collaborate closely with design.

 Strong track record of taking initiative, owning outcomes, and bridging dependencies.

 Be a sponge. You don't need to be a finance or investment expert, but you'll need to absorb complex topics quickly (subledger reconciliation, mutual fund trading flow) and apply strong product fundamentals.

 Experience with agile software development, delivering features and outcomes consistently.

 Comfortable with product toolkits such as Linear, Slite, Miro, and Figma.

 Familiarity with API documentation standards and an interest in how AI agents consume APIs (MCP or similar) is a strong plus.

 
 How we Upvest in you:

 Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe

You will combine strategic thinking with a strong focus on execution. In this role, you will work closely with the executive team, senior leadership and teams across Product, Tech, Content, Marketing, Finance and Operations.

jobs.title: Product Manager Intern
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. 
 

 Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. 
 

 Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. 
 At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. 
 

 How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. 
 

 We're looking for a curious Product Manager Intern to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data, Design and Go-to-market to turn customer feedback into product improvements, align on tradeoffs across teams, and help shape the experience our customers rely on every day. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys talking to customers, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and likes untangling problems that cut across multiple product areas. to join our team and contribute to the evolution of Aircall's core product.  Key Responsibilities : 
 
 Customer Insights & Product Development 

 Meet directly with customers to gather feedback, discuss pain points, and validate potential improvements.

 Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback into clear opportunities, and translate them into product recommendations that shape the roadmap.

 Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize enhancements that improve user experience and agent efficiency.

 Align dependencies and facilitate tradeoff discussions with stakeholders across product areas.

 Follow the development cycle end-to-end to ensure we ship the best possible experience in an agile manner.

 Contribute to Knowledge Base articles, FAQs and product demos to support launches and go-to-market.

 

 Product Analysis & Optimization 

 Gather and synthesize usage and performance data from multiple sources (interaction logs, analytics, customer feedback).

 Identify patterns, bottlenecks and opportunities in product workflows, and turn them into more intuitive experiences.

 Use modern data tools and, where relevant, AI/LLM-based approaches to enrich analysis and uncover deeper insights.

 

 Monitoring & Performance 

 Research, recommend and help implement tools and frameworks for tracking key product metrics (e.g. latency, reliability, usability).

 Collaborate with teams to define and monitor KPIs aligned with product goals.

 Help set up dashboards, alerts and reports to support ongoing performance evaluation and decision-making.

 Qualifications : 
 

 Master's student from an engineering or business school or university.

 Fluent in English.

 Comfortable running customer conversations — asking good questions, listening carefully, and following up.

 Comfortable working across teams, aligning dependencies and navigating tradeoffs with peers and stakeholders.

 A first experience (internship) in a product or project team is a plus.

 Knowledge of SaaS, product development cycles, and our business is a plus.
